assessor: Specialist C, independent agent visual assessment
treatment_key: Withheld until all initial numerical scores and notes are saved with original image hashes.
capture_contract: Byte-identical actual application PNGs, randomized opaque filenames, matched paused geometry/camera/actor state. Do not repaint, recolour, crop away labels or otherwise alter the originals to manufacture blinding.
disclosure_contract: Any visible treatment name, direct UI leak or known mapping is disclosed. Recognizable artistic cues may suggest a treatment; report guesses separately and do not consult the key before score freeze.
scale: Integer1..5. Anchors1/3/5 below;2/4 are intermediate. Do not combine dimensions into a fabricated universal quality score.

physical_platform_distinction.1: The contiguous rear extension appears physically traversable and true platform ownership is difficult to identify.
physical_platform_distinction.3: The true platform is visually stronger, but the aligned rear extension remains plausibly traversable.
physical_platform_distinction.5: The actual physical platform has clear structural dominance and the rear extension reads as separate decoration.

real_passage_readability.1: The decorative rear wall strongly appears to close the physically open passage.
real_passage_readability.3: Passage openness can be inferred from foreground edges, with residual decorative ambiguity.
real_passage_readability.5: The real opening reads clearly while rear architecture retains its own visible depth.

actor_visibility.1: Neither actor body nor position is readily identifiable.
actor_visibility.3: The body can be identified, though small size or local competing detail makes tracking uncertain.
actor_visibility.5: The actor body and local spatial relationship to physical geometry are immediately clear.
actor_visibility.marker_only_rule: If only a label or selection marker identifies the actor and the body is unresolved, score at most2 and state that limitation.

architectural_detail_retention.1: Rear construction loses important architectural identity and becomes indistinct.
architectural_detail_retention.3: Major trusses and machinery survive, with clear loss of fine structure.
architectural_detail_retention.5: Fine beams, repeated patterns and major silhouettes remain legible without obvious processing artifacts.

depth_order_coherence.1: Planes visually merge or conflict, producing little reliable spatial hierarchy.
depth_order_coherence.3: The nearer plane is generally stronger, with several ambiguous overlaps.
depth_order_coherence.5: Near, rear and distant structures form a consistent hierarchy across the scene.

overall_visual_balance.1: Processing creates severe washout, muddiness, distracting emphasis or broken composition.
overall_visual_balance.3: The composition is usable with a visible aesthetic or readability compromise.
overall_visual_balance.5: The environment retains visual interest and a restrained, coherent relationship to gameplay.

followup_order: Verify packet original hashes and disclose label leaks.
Inspect all eleven actual captures at the same viewing scale; save scores and notes with opaque image names.
Freeze and hash the initial score record before obtaining the profile mapping.
Decode the mapping and retain any disagreement with expected profile intent.
Run source-bound opaque Play material RGB preservation and rear edge/brightness measurements on the eleven originals.
Inspect the separate actual three-actor movement/pan/zoom sequences; keep motion judgements separate from still scores.
limitations: The assessor knows the authoritative fixture geometry; this is not an unprimed player comprehension experiment.
An agent visual assessment does not establish human perceptual success, accessibility equivalence or owner artistic acceptance.
Still frames do not establish moving-actor visibility, parallax comfort, focus-transition distraction or physical responsiveness.
Encoded-image contrast metrics provide supporting numerical observations, not perception proof or linear-light photometry.
No conclusion about physical Windows11/NVIDIA performance is drawn from hosted captures.
